prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one square picture-dictionary illustration for an Android app teaching familiar animals of Bangladesh.
Primary request: Create one premium, almost-real illustration of an adult Bengal tiger. A lifelike hand-painted digital illustration with subtle stylization, convincing anatomy and natural proportions; beautifully observed realistic fur, authentic orange coat with black stripes, white cheek ruffs, chest and underside, natural amber eyes, whiskers and rounded ears. It should feel approachable and calm while remaining a real wild animal.
Scene/backdrop: clean warm ivory background with only a subtle natural contact shadow under the paws. No scenery or decorative shapes.
Composition/framing: single tiger, entire body visible from ears to paws to tail tip, standing in an elegant relaxed three-quarter side view, head gently turned toward the viewer, mouth closed. Clearly readable silhouette, anatomically correct four legs, natural tail curve. Subject centered and fills roughly 80 percent of square canvas, generous safe margin, no cropping.
Style/medium: high-end realistic wildlife illustration, near photographic detail with softly refined painted edges and carefully simplified forms, tactile fine fur and dimensional shading. Natural size eyes and head; no exaggerated cartoon features. Soft diffuse daylight, warm but accurate colors, clear detail at small mobile thumbnail size.
Constraints: one animal only; no text, label, typography, border, watermark, props, clothing or accessories. No thick black outlines, flat vector shapes, plastic or toy appearance, chibi proportions, oversized eyes, human expression, aggressive pose, heavy shadow or blurred image-padding bands. Deliver a polished single square image, not a collage.
